checklistGeneric: Peer review completed and comments resolved
checklistSpecific: PR is approved by a reviewer other than the author
All CI checks (build, tests, quality gates) green on the merge commit
Target release version/tag recorded on the approval
Rollback plan referenced in the approval note

testing.expected: Merged PR shows a required approval and passing status checks before promotion

checklistGeneric: Peer review completed and comments resolved
checklistSpecific: Join keys validated for cardinality (no unintended fan-out)
Unmatched/null-key rows routed to a reject table with a recorded count
Reference/master data version pinned for reproducibility
Row count post-join reconciles to source within tolerance
Match rate against master data meets the agreed threshold

testing.expected: No duplicate rows introduced by enrichment joins (post-join key count equals source key count)
Reject table populated with counted unmatched keys after the run

checklistSpecific: Deployment triggered from a tagged, protected-branch commit
Automated rollback step present and dry-run verified in the pipeline
Prod job version matches the approved artifact version
Post-deploy smoke run confirms the job schedules and starts

testing.expected: CI/CD run shows a successful deploy job with a rollback stage configured

checklistGeneric: Peer review completed and comments resolved
checklistSpecific: Business rules, joins, aggregations, and enrichment sources listed in the design doc
Source-to-target mapping documented for every target column
Grain of each target model explicitly stated
Enrichment reference/master datasets named with owners

testing.expected: Design document with a complete source-to-target mapping exists and is linked to the ticket

checklistGeneric: Peer review completed and comments resolved
checklistSpecific: Trim/case/whitespace normalization applied to standardized string fields
Code values conformed to the central reference list (no free-text variants)
Null and default-value handling defined per column
Date/number formats standardized to the canonical type
Record counts before and after cleansing reconciled and logged

testing.expected: No non-conforming code values remain in standardized columns after the transform

checklistGeneric: Peer review completed and comments resolved
checklistSpecific: Transform models committed to the repo with build passing
Model dependencies (refs/sources) resolve in the DAG
Incremental/materialization strategy set per model
Re-run produces identical output (idempotency confirmed)

testing.expected: Orchestration DAG runs the transform models end to end with all nodes succeeding

checklistSpecific: Curated (Gold) tables populated with expected partitions present
Audit columns (load timestamp, batch id) populated on every row
Table statistics refreshed after materialization
Prior version retained/swappable for rollback

testing.expected: Curated tables exist and return non-zero rows for the latest load partition

checklistSpecific: Job duration compared against the baseline and within SLA
Row counts per run recorded and trended
Error/retry rate reviewed with anomalies flagged
Dashboard panel shows the latest run status green

testing.expected: Monitoring dashboard shows duration, row-count, and error-rate metrics for the latest transformation run

checklistSpecific: Affected datasets and downstream consumers identified from lineage
Notification states reprocessing window and restated partitions
Consumer acknowledgement captured on the ticket
Restatement noted against the data contract/SLA

testing.expected: Reprocessing notification recorded and sent to every downstream consumer of the affected dataset

checklistGeneric: Peer review completed and comments resolved
checklistSpecific: Query plan reviewed and full-table scans on large tables removed
Partition pruning / predicate pushdown confirmed active
Compute/cluster sizing right-sized against cost target
Runtime meets the performance target with output unchanged

testing.expected: Optimized run meets the target runtime and produces output identical to the pre-optimization baseline

checklistGeneric: Peer review completed and comments resolved
checklistSpecific: Transformation logic reviewed against the source-to-target mapping
Naming, modularity, and ELT/coding standards checked
Static analysis / linter findings resolved or waived
All review comments resolved before approval

testing.expected: PR shows completed review with all threads resolved and no open static-analysis blockers

checklistSpecific: Requirement logged as a ticket with requesting team and priority
Target consumers and expected output grain captured
Acceptance criteria and refresh SLA recorded
Source datasets referenced by catalog name

testing.expected: Transformation request logged as a ticket with acceptance criteria and named source datasets

checklistSpecific: Root cause of the failure identified and noted on the incident ticket
Fix applied and re-run restricted to the affected partitions
Re-run is idempotent (no duplicate or partial rows)
Post-run counts reconcile to expected volumes

testing.expected: Failed job completes successfully on re-run with reconciled row counts and a root-cause note on the ticket

checklistGeneric: Peer review completed and comments resolved
checklistSpecific: Integration tests run against a staging copy of production data
Downstream consumer outputs validated against expected results
Schema/data-contract compatibility check passes
Test run recorded green in CI before promotion

testing.expected: Staging integration test suite passes and downstream consumer validation returns expected results

checklistGeneric: Peer review completed and comments resolved
checklistSpecific: Each business rule mapped to a concrete column-level transformation
Glossary terms linked for every derived field
Edge cases and default handling specified per rule
Spec reviewed and signed off by the requesting stakeholder

testing.expected: Transformation spec documents a build-ready rule-to-column mapping with glossary links

checklistGeneric: Peer review completed and comments resolved
checklistSpecific: Unit tests assert transform output against curated fixtures
Edge-case and null-handling cases covered by tests
Tests run automatically in the CI build
All unit tests pass on the feature branch

testing.expected: CI build runs the transformation unit tests and all pass against expected fixtures

checklistGeneric: Peer review completed and comments resolved
checklistSpecific: Lineage entries reflect the new/modified transform steps
Column-level lineage resolves from source to curated target
Technical and business metadata refreshed on affected assets
No orphaned or stale lineage edges remain for removed steps

testing.expected: Catalog lineage for the affected model matches the current transformation DAG end to end

checklistSpecific: Curated row count compared against expected volume for the load
Source-to-target count reconciliation within defined tolerance
Variance beyond tolerance flagged and investigated before sign-off
Reconciliation result recorded on the run/ticket

testing.expected: Row-count reconciliation between source and curated model passes within tolerance and is logged
